currentParagraphText: “What do you mean you don’t know what it is?” Artemis frowned. “Is it something you found, or?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “What do you mean you don’t know what it is?” Artemis frowned. “Is it something you found, or?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “No,” Jake shook his head and clarified: “It was created by the Malefic Viper specifically to be given to you.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: He would definitely not put it above the snake god to have given him a gag gift. However, he also couldn’t write off the option that it was a genuinely great gift. Something that would benefit Artemis greatly, and if there was even a one percent chance it was something good, Jake wouldn’t be an ass and deny it to her.
